scope: Finite startup failure and safe liveness checks for owner-local group danger assessment
finding: DangerRequest passed stored handles to completedFSM and published new execFSM results without type/range validation. Invalid startup could be retried from subsequent coalesced danger events.
implementation: Running handle reuse requires an array with exact owner epoch/generation and finite nonnegative integral numeric handle before completedFSM.
New execFSM result is validated before liveness check/publication. Invalid startup clears the running marker, records one local epoch/generation/server-time failure and logs it once.
Subsequent danger requests in that owner epoch return without another startup until existing observer cleanup/reset clears failure. A new owner epoch is independent. No retry timer or worker.
A valid already-completed FSM is not treated as startup failure or republished as running, preserving legitimate immediate finite drain.

Existing source regression checks handle guards precede completedFSM, failure gate precedes execFSM, completed-handle conditional publication and setup reset. Generation assertion retains strict identity comparison.

validation.focusedInitial: .qa/danger-startup-focused.log failed one stale generation comparison spelling assertion; updated to strict isEqualTo

limits: No native failure injection, physical behaviour or performance evidence. Audits remain paused; no Arma launch.
The terminal failure is not automatic recovery or proof of a working danger group brain. A legitimate cleanup/reset or new owner context is needed before a fresh attempt.
No new LAMBS source review or parity percentage claim. This is a CBE execution-foundation correction. Protected sources unchanged.
